name: claudown-bridge
description: Optional community workaround: shows claudown's 5-hour usage reading in the VS Code status bar and runs the transcript sensor on a timer, because the Claude Code panel does not run statusLine.

commands.title: claudown: Switch Claude Code to terminal mode (full status line sensor)

claudown.pythonPath.description: Python 3.8+ to run the sensor with. Empty = python on Windows, python3 elsewhere.

claudown.sensorScript.description: Path to vscode_transcript_sensor.py. Empty = ~/.claude/claudown/vscode_transcript_sensor.py (where the installer puts it).

claudown.intervalSeconds.description: How often to read local transcripts.

claudown.threshold.description: Only used to colour the status bar item. The real threshold lives in your Claude Code settings.
